question: Neha said, "The boy playing cricket is the son of my father's only sister." Who is the boy to Neha?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

As per the given information,

 
• 
 
**My father’s only sister** → Neha’s **aunt** (father’s sister)

 
 
• 
 
**The son of my father’s only sister** → Neha’s **aunt’s son**

 

An aunt’s son is Neha’s **cousin**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3f986ed65d038a994c374cde5722b9d12e71a5bba6207cb80fe2440f2ae155f.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
